expected: Executive designates lead agency; lead agency develops plan, holds public hearing, conducts reviews. Preserve inherited actor on list children.
Public hearing during development requires sufficient time and statewide notice; separate legislative hearing at least every three years. Do not conflate frequencies.
State must submit plan covering one to two fiscal years at least thirty days before first fiscal year; preserve recipient Secretary.

Every one of the thirteen required State-plan contents survives with the parent requirement to include assurance, description or information; scan sublists as well. Do not treat every assured downstream action as a directly commanded standalone action.
Literacy initiatives, youth examples and fatherhood initiatives remain optional/nonexhaustive examples within required plan content.
Preserve where appropriate for energy crisis programs and maximum extent possible for partnerships; no universal requirement to deliver every listed program.
Protected prior-year funding, proportional share, notice, record hearing, cause and Secretary review survive. Redistribution grounds apply to reduction; do not silently extend them to termination.
State requires each entity to establish petition procedures for named people/organizations believing representation inadequate; retain actors and trigger.
Community action plan with community-needs assessment is a funding condition for each entity; Secretary submission only on request; coordinating assessments remains optional.

Performance system permits ROMA, Secretary-facilitated or qualifying alternative; requires outcome description and information on carrying out assurances. Preserve fiscal-year-2001 historical deadline.
Executive may revise; revised plan must then be submitted; original and revised plans must be available for public inspection.
Transition displacing (a)-(c) is limited to fiscal year 2000; must not become universal current exemption.
At least ninety percent goes to grants to eligible entities for statutory purposes; minimum not maximum.

Obligation in grant year and succeeding year subject to recapture; recapture is permissive, after FY end, only if unobligated funds exceed twenty percent; redistribution alternatives/locality retained.
Admin cap is greater of $55,000 or five percent, includes monitoring, excludes (b)(1)(A) training/technical assistance; tax-credit startup/admin counts. Retain remainder funding source.
Eligible entity requires prior qualifying status OR designation under 9909, AND appropriate board/mechanism under 9910. Cross-section target location and semantic completeness scored separately.

Private board: one third elected officials or representatives; appointive substitution only when elected officials insufficient/willing. At least one third democratically selected low-income representation with neighborhood residence; remainder community interests.
Public organizations may use qualifying tripartite board OR another State-specified participatory mechanism; do not import private-board composition into both branches.

Unserved area AND executive chooses service trigger designation; near-area entity expands representation; political subdivision fallback only if no qualified nonprofit identified; priority is permissive.
State onsite reviews every three years, new entity after first funded year, followup for failures; Secretary evaluations and report trigger State plan of action. State may request assistance.
Final review finding triggers deficiency notice and correction; offer appropriate assistance/report OR report reasons assistance inappropriate.
Allowing quality-improvement plan is discretionary with seriousness/time factors; sixty days to develop/implement from notice; thirty days from receipt to approve OR explain refusal.
Proceedings require notice/hearing and apply unless entity corrects deficiency; preserve termination OR reduction.

Secretary review on request, ninety days after all necessary documentation, then State decision final on day ninety if unfinished. Direct assistance authorized for premature funding action until violation corrected, with offsetting State reduction.
